== Summary ==
Original Players Committee Virtual slip: •Blizzard 2 (V), from the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Page 4, left column, row 5, slip “30”. Old pre-template slip (before the Players Committee remastered the set in December 2006). Cropped unchanged from a 300 dpi render of the PDF page (no retouching).

Source: https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4

archive.org copy of this exact original (SHA-1 checked by archive.org): [https://archive.org/download/swccg-wiki-images-9/95/VS4-2003-30-Blizzard_2.png Internet Archive item].
